title: Oozy Creamy Uruguayan Stilton Cheese Casserole
description: A floral and creamy Uruguayan dish featuring stilton cheese, cooked in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot, suitable for an ayurvedic tamasic friendly diet. This energizing casserole is perfect for a dinner meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Prepare the ttukbaegi earthenware pot by applying a thin layer of oil and heating it in the oven for 10 minutes.
In a large skillet, saute the chopped onion and minced garlic until the onion is translucent.
In a large bowl, combine the sauteed onion and garlic, crumbled stilton cheese, chopped parsley, heavy cream, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Transfer the mixture to the prepared earthenware pot.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until it is golden brown and the cheese is melted and oozy.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the casserole hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
